title: Luke Walton Signed Spalding Mini NBA Basketball, Lakers Auto
descriptionText:
Spalding mini NBA basketball signed by Luke Walton (#4).
Signature is in silver marker and displays clearly. Ball is in good overall condition with light handling wear. Please review all photos carefully for condition and autograph placement.
No certificate of authenticity (COA) is included. Signature is believed to be authentic based on source but has not been professionally authenticated and is priced accordingly.
